messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up — we have 6 campus hires starting next Monday. Need to confirm who still needs I-9 verification + background-check receipts. Can folks owning each candidate chime in?
Jonas: I can handle badge provisioning and door access. Who's delivering laptop imaging?
Priya: I'm owning the candidate list. Two of them still need to finish the I-9 step (remote hires) and one has a pending address verification with Checkr.
Maya: Thanks Priya. For I-9: remote folks can do an authorized agent visit or come by HQ on Monday 9–11am. Please have them bring passport OR driver license + SS card. @Avery T. — which option did you pick?
Avery T.: I'll be on campus Monday, will swing by HR at 9:15. Bringing passport.
Checkr Bot: Candidate Avery T. — background check cleared (ID + county records). Report ID: chk_8f3b.
Priya: Marking Avery as complete. Remaining: Carlos and Mei (both remote). I emailed them the agent list + instructions yesterday, no replies yet.
Maya: Can someone follow up by EOD? We need results before payroll cutoff on Friday.
Jonas: I'll ping Carlos — also need his office workstation assigned. Quick note for IT: if they're joining remotely and then on-site, set up temporary guest wifi until badge is active.
HR Forms: Payroll forms link: https://redwood.example/hr/newhire-forms. Carlos/Mei — fill the W-4 + direct deposit before start to avoid pay delay.
Priya: I'll escalate to recruiter and set 4pm reminder to follow up.
Maya: Perfect. Also planning a 30-min Day-1 orientation at 10:30am in Conf B for campus folks, remote folks join via Meet. Agenda: welcome, benefits overview, Slack setup, security baseline. Any objections?
Jonas: Sounds good. Can we add a 10-min badge/photo window right after orientation?
Maya: Yep — 11:10 photo & badge pickup. I'll update the calendar invites.
Avery T.: Thanks! Quick Q — where do we sign the equity docs?
HR Forms: Equity docs are signed through the portal in the newhire email. Link at top of the forms page.
Maya: OK team — follow-ups: Jonas — badge + wifi, Priya — candidate nudges, HR Forms — confirm payroll link sent. I'll close the loop once all I-9s are done. :thumbsup:
Priya: On it.
Jonas: Got it, prepping images and temporary creds now.
